text: {"lessons":["My early sales of A, B, and D locked in losses, while later trades in C and E had mixed outcomes; I should base each decision on the stock’s current outlook, not on my purchase price or the urge to undo a past trade.","Adding to C after its price rose and later selling portions at very different prices shows how quickly exposure can grow; I should set position limits before adding and reassess the whole portfolio, not just one holding.","Account value moved up and down despite periods with no trades, so inactivity is not automatically a mistake and trading is not automatically useful; I should avoid acting unless a specific, evidence-based change in my view warrants it."]}
